r: The rtla is a meta-tool that includes a set of commands that aims to analyze the real-time properties of Linux. But instead of testing Linux as a black box, rtla leverages kernel tracing capabilities to provide precise information about the properties and root causes of unexpected results.

osnoise
Gives information about the operating system noise (osnoise).


timerlat
Measures the IRQ and thread timer latency.

-h, --help
Display the help text.


For other options, see the man page for the corresponding command.
